capabilities: Track habits and projects as draggable square cards on a daily view
Record check-ins with confirm, count, text, date, and attachment entries
Review progress in weekly and monthly views with statistics
Write all records back to plain Markdown notes
Archive projects while keeping their history
disambiguation: Not a drawing or canvas tool; the 'squares' are clickable tracking cells for habits and projects.
extras: Freemium: unlicensed use is limited to 2 projects; a paid authorization key unlocks unlimited projects and future scheduling in the monthly view. Source code is closed and not redistributable. Keys are obtained via Xiaohongshu (小红书, search 焦应行). README warns not to expose .obsidian/plugins/square/data.json, which may contain settings and authorization state. No client telemetry; requires Obsidian 1.11.4+.
intentEvidence: 数据留在 Obsidian Markdown 里 | 数据锁在独立 App 或云端
motivation: The author built it for people who already record life, goals, or projects in Obsidian and find task lists too bare and standalone habit apps too detached from their notes.
problem: Daily check-in and habit tracking usually lives in separate apps with locked-in data, while Obsidian has no dedicated interface for recording repeated daily activities.
summary: Habit and project tracker that shows each tracked item as a small square grid cell, records check-ins, and writes entries back to Markdown notes.
